responsibility: Implements graphical dumping of GCC control-flow graphs as GraphViz DOT files. It is responsible for opening and bracketing .dot outputs, rendering each function as a clustered subgraph, formatting basic-block nodes with labels produced by dump_bb_for_graph, organizing loop bodies into nested loop clusters when loop information is available, and emitting CFG edges with styles and colors that reflect fallthrough, abnormal, fake, back-edge, and probability information so passes can produce visual CFG dumps.
same_name_distinction: This is the graph group's DOT-emission implementation: it renders CFG basic blocks, loop clusters, and styled edges, and manages opening/starting/finishing .dot dump files. Unlike graph.h, which only declares the small public entry points for graph dumping, this file contains the actual GraphViz formatting and file-output logic.
